title: Open and measure standalone OBJ through the native engine
scope: Wire standalone OBJ into the real scan.open worker/session and native info/fit-plane CLI, preserving missing-texture notices and bounded source refusals. Companion image loading is excluded.
acceptance: Standalone OBJ opens through the engine with original-equivalent mesh, summary, source and session state on success and refusal; a wrong Rust state fails the comparison.
CLI supplies files and formats results while the engine owns parsing, state and measurements.
open_items: Work in progress from main ed5170c, independent of PR110. Existing 33 import comparisons retained; 15 OBJ controls added to the same corpus.
No roster or verification-level promotion in this PR; those remain the owner-scheduled M3 batch. Image wiring, 3MF/STEP native commands and compatible project IO remain separate.
